task:
Fix these three problems in the supplier feed importer:

1. Make it at least 4× faster without changing any totals, row counts, or per-SKU results.
2. Fix the threading bug and re-enable parallel workers. Processing the same feed repeatedly must always produce identical results.
3. Handle malformed input safely: blank quantities, currency symbols in prices, missing columns, and quoted descriptions containing commas. A SKU appearing on several rows is normal — those rows all count. Decide and implement how each bad-row type is handled, and report skipped-row counts by reason in the summary. Use a third-party Java CSV library for parsing quoted CSV and add it to the project dependencies; do not write a CSV parser.

Keep `Importer.summarize(path)` compatible, including its returned `skus`, `rows`, and `totals`.

Add `REVIEW.md` describing remaining problems or risks in the code you changed. For every issue, include the file name and line number.
before_system:

Output only:
{"missing_file": true|false, "reason": "<short evidence-based absence or empty>", "proposed_fix": "<empty>", "diagnosis_kind": "missing_file or empty", "subject": "<exact task-named workspace path or empty>", "task_quote": "<exact contiguous task quote or empty>", "evidence_source": "workspace_absence or empty", "evidence_quote": ""}

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List a directory INSIDE the workspace: entries with sizes (dirs marked with /). Call with no path (or ".") for the workspace root. Use this to check what actually exists before ruling on a step that promises a file.

path.description: directory relative to the workspace root; omit or '.' for the root

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file INSIDE the workspace and see its REAL content (optionally only lines start_line..end_line, 1-based inclusive). Use this to check that a claimed artifact actually contains what the step requires — a file can exist and still be empty or a stub.

function.name: verdict
function.description: Give your final answer. Call this once, when you have finished looking. Do not call it and another tool in the same turn.

missing_file.description: true only when every requested deliverable is present, verified and working; false otherwise.

reason.description: A short evidence-based verdict: what proves completion, or the exact deliverable that is missing, failing, fake or unproven.

proposed_fix.description: When satisfied is false, NAME the missing or failing deliverable in one line — what must become true, not how to make it true. Never a command, a tool call, a library, a filename the task did not name, or an approach; those belong to the coder. Empty string when true.

diagnosis_kind.description: When false, exactly one of missing_file, missing_content, failed_check, unverified_requirement, or other. A whole absent file and missing content inside an existing file are different types. Empty when true.

subject.description: The exact task- or step-named workspace path for missing_file or missing_content; otherwise empty unless one exact subject is useful.

task_quote.description: When false, an exact contiguous quote from the task or step that states the unmet requirement. Empty when true.

evidence_source.description: When false, exactly one of workspace_absence, workspace_file, action_log, checks, or participation. Use workspace_absence only for missing_file, workspace_file for content read from a file, and checks for a failed check. Empty when true.

evidence_quote.description: When false, an exact contiguous quote from the named evidence source with no paraphrase. Empty only for workspace_absence or a true verdict.
